LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.5: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Performing and Displaying in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How is a good tone produced on the descant recorder?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. play notes G A B C’ D’ on the descant recorder,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. play a melody built on the notes G A B C’ D’ on the descant recorder applying appropriate techniques,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. create a random repeat pattern based on the notes G A B C’ D’,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. play notes G A B C’ D’ on the descant recorder,

   Descant Recorder helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. play a melody built on the notes G A B C’ D’ on the descant recorder applying appropriate techniques,

   Descant Recorder helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. create a random repeat pattern based on the notes G A B C’ D’,

   Descant Recorder helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. practice playing the notes G A and B observing the correct fingering, breath control, tonguing and tone quality, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology.

2. observe the baroque fingering chart for note C’ and D’ and practice fingering the notes,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. practice playing the notes G A and B observing the correct fingering, breath control, tonguing and tone quality, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or use assistive technology.
2. observe the baroque fingering chart for note C’ and D’ and practice fingering the notes,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: The learner connects to digital resources to search for information on how notes are played on the descant

recorder.

● Communication and collaboration: developed as learners perform and execute skills in groups.

Values:
● Unity: The learner works with peers to review performances of melodies. on a descant recorder by their peers.

● Respect: The learner critiques peers’ recorder performances using polite language. love as he/she works together with

others in the different presentations and skill performances.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: The learner collaborates with others while mounting, playing notes on the descant recorder.

● Safety and security: The learner becomes more aware of cyber security practices as they responsibly search and watch a

video on how to play notes C’ and D’.

Link to other learning areas:

English: The Learner uses English as the language of communication in providing feedback on peers’ performances of

melodies on the descant recorder.

Learners must cover at least one of these areas:

1. Swimming

2. Indigenous Kenyan Games
